_comment: Notes are the author's words, never the agent's (D-06, JUDG-01): a fix given bare is asked what the next draft should change, never offered note text, and a note is recorded exactly as the author typed it, as the whole quoted --note or the whole stdin of --note-file -; words carrying a backtick or a $ are single-quoted, never double-quoted. The review cases replay a drafted review in record mode; the write case replays an unsteered redraft and the author's answer to the STOP.
